name: Staten Island Bird Club
region_note: COMPANION BIRDS (parrots, budgies, cockatiels, finches, doves, backyard poultry)
notes: A Staten Island companion-bird club focused on proper care, handling and rearing of pet birds - one of the few IN-NYC-borough bird resources. Not a formal shelter, but a real local community for care advice, member rehoming and lost-and-found. Confirm current meeting schedule/venue via Facebook before attending. Phone: (via club / All Saints Episcopal Church venue) Email: (via club contacts / FB) Intake: Attend a meeting (historically 3rd Thursday, All Saints Episcopal Church, Woolley Ave, Staten Island) or reach via Facebook Intake: club offers care guidance and member-to-member rehoming/lost-found
type_raw: Companion-bird club (education, care, community; some adoption/lost-found)
